liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **You Can Be Your Silhouette**: rare: 8 archived performances [4]
- **Welcome To An Altered Future**: rare: 11 archived performances [4]
- **Swan Song**: rare: 14 archived performances [4]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-09-01.ToraTapesMX** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 214 min [1]
- **kglw2024-09-01.SBD**: soundboard; 28 songs; 196 min [2]
- **kglw2024-09-01.ToraTapesAUD**: audience recording; 28 songs; 196 min [3]

## Around the show

- Ambrose played saxophone, with teases for Sad Pilot, Converge, and Witchcraft [1]
- Described as about donkeys and dedicated to soundman Joe Santarpia [1]
- Ambrose played saxophone, with teases for Sad Pilot, Converge, and Witchcraft [2]
- Contained Bitter Boogie teases and was dedicated to Magic Sam [2]
- Ambrose played saxophone, with teases for Sad Pilot, Converge, and Witchcraft [3]
- Described as about donkeys and dedicated to soundman Joe Santarpia [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-09-01.ToraTapesMX**: taped by Tora Tapes, Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; transferred by Tora Tapes; source: AUD+SBD > WAV [1]
- **kglw2024-09-01.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; source: SBD [2]
- **kglw2024-09-01.ToraTapesAUD**: taped by Tora Tapes; transferred by Tora Tapes; source: AUD > WAV [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by KGLW.net: [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard setlist - 2024-09-01 Huntington Bank Pavilion at Northerly Island, Chicago, IL, USA](https://kglw.net/setlists/king-gizzard-the-lizard-wizard-september-1-2024-huntington-bank-pavilion-at-northerly-island-chicago-il-usa.html) [5]
- Poster by Huntington Bank Pavilion at Northerly Island: [King Gizzard and The Lizard Wizard Tickets | 1 September 2024 | Huntington Bank Pavilion at Northerly Island](https://www.pavilionnortherlyisland.com/events/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-01-september-2024/) [6]
- Poster by @swaycout: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Northerly Island Chicago IL September 1 2024 Poster](https://swaycout.com/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-northerly-island-chicago-il-september-1-2024-poster/) [7]
